metadata.description: General-purpose Claude Code skills — versioned, validated, installable. Domain-agnostic authoring aids that aren't tied to any one plugin's job, distributed as cohesive skill-bundle plugins.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Design-domain skills: layout-decomposer (read/grade/design a UI on OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT axes + a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library), mermaid-decomposer (create/grade advanced Mermaid diagrams on INTENT x RENDER axes + a gated M1-M6 rubric + a mechanized render-check), color-science (perceptual color — spaces, gamut, contrast/APCA, harmony, CVD — with a TypeScript color library + 54 interactive demos), and typography-lettering (type anatomy, classification, metrics, scripts, and the modern CSS text surface).
